items.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022
items.q: Most of the stuff I played with him was written in normal so-called classical notation.

ctx.x: Most of the stuff I played with him was written in normal so-called classical notation. Then there would maybe be some little squiggles to indicate so many seconds of improvising. Because as time went on he wrote more and he structured the improvisations more so that sometimes when he would be improvising I would be playing a written piano piece underneath it. And stuff like that. It was a real collage.
And you were listening for cues as to when we’re moving on?
